course_name_en: Planning and Operation of Pumping Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Students know how centrifugal pumps are used for pumping pure liquids or mixtures with proportions of gases and solid particles.

Students are able to describe the diverse requirements for performance data such as delivery head, flow rate, suction behavior, operating fluid, and installation conditions of turbomachinery for general and special applications.
Students master the basic knowledge on centrifugal pump systems, from characteristic curves and their control to suction behavior, system characteristic curve, and operating point.
Furthermore, students know the functionality of shaft seals and bearings, axial thrust, and drives.

syllabus_topics: Characteristic curves and control: Change of rotational speed, impeller diameter, bypass control, minimum flow rate, series / parallel connection
System characteristic curve and operating point: Head loss / pressure loss calculation for pipelines, fittings, adapters, parallel and series connection, parallel operation of centrifugal pumps

assessment_methods.method: Elaboration of experimental evaluation and/or colloquium Hydraulic laboratory

assessment_rules: The form of examination will be announced at the beginning of the course. Award of credit points requires a passed module examination. The grade is weighted according to ECTS credit points.
